Resident request values exclude interpreter initialization; fresh-process initialization is reported separately in the evidence table.
Python array-to-tuple construction is timed. Ordinary Python scans/integers/authority differ from MiniPy; these are not equivalent sandbox rankings.
Memory sums participating-process PSS (including fork parent); requested-allocation counters are not compared across runtimes.
